items.title: Seizing the AI opportunity
items.summary: Meeting the demands of the Intelligence Age will require strategic investment in energy and infrastructure. OpenAI’s submission to the White House details how expanding capacity and workforce readiness can sustain U.S. leadership in AI and economic growth.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI向白宫提交报告，阐述在智能时代维持美国AI领导地位与经济增长的战略路径。报告指出，随着大模型需求的飞速增长，必须对能源供应、基础设施扩容以及劳动力准备进行战略性投资。通过扩大算力基础支撑与培养专业人才，能够有效应对智能化发展过程中的资源挑战，为AI生态体系建设提供坚实保障。

items.title: Addendum to GPT-5 System Card: Sensitive conversations
items.summary: This system card details GPT-5’s improvements in handling sensitive conversations, including new benchmarks for emotional reliance, mental health, and jailbreak resistance.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布GPT-5系统卡片补充说明，重点评估模型在处理敏感对话方面的安全性能。该补充文件引入了针对情感依赖、心理健康以及越狱攻击防御的新基准测试，详细阐述了GPT-5在识别心理困境与防范安全漏洞上的系统级提升。这为大模型安全评估与敏感交互治理提供了全新的标准与参考样例。

items.title: Strengthening ChatGPT’s responses in sensitive conversations
items.summary: OpenAI collaborated with 170+ mental health experts to improve ChatGPT’s ability to recognize distress, respond empathetically, and guide users toward real-world support—reducing unsafe responses by up to 80%. Learn how we’re making ChatGPT safer and more supportive in sensitive moments.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI联合170多名心理健康专家，共同优化ChatGPT在敏感场景下的交互响应能力。通过增强模型识别困境、提供共情回应以及引导真实救援的能力，ChatGPT在敏感对话中的不安全回复减少了高达80%。该项目展示了跨学科协作在大模型对齐与安全防护方面的显著成效，提升了产品安全性。

items.title: Steuerrecht.com delivers client-ready legal analysis with ChatGPT
items.summary: Steuerrecht.com uses ChatGPT Business to streamline legal workflows, automate tax research, and deliver faster, client-ready analysis for law firms.
items.summaryZh: 法律服务平台Steuerrecht.com引入ChatGPT Business以优化其工作流程。该平台利用大模型自动化税务研究，为律所提供更快速且可直接交付客户的法律分析。这体现了大语言模型在特定垂直行业如法律与税务领域的实用落地案例。
